create_JunctionData: create a JunctionData container with junctions, values, and metadata DataFrame for splice junction analysis
filter_by_ontology: filter JunctionData tracks by ontology CURIE term such as UBERON to isolate specific tissue data
filter_to_strand: filter JunctionData to keep only positive or negative strand splice junctions using filter_to_positive_strand
intersect_with_interval: filter JunctionData to keep only junctions that overlap a given genomic Interval region
get_junctions_to_plot: get splice junctions above a k-threshold for a named track and strand to prepare for plotting
